about.description: ST0x is a blockchain-based platform providing infrastructure for tokenization and on-chain financial services. It enables users to access and trade diverse digital assets through decentralized protocols.
about.registryInfo: ST0x is a Base-native tokenized-stock platform. Issues stock tokens backed 1:1 by underlying equities held in segregated US broker-dealer custody. Targets retail / DeFi distribution with permissionless transfer and KYC-only at mint/redeem.

fees.revenueNotes: ST0x charges a primary-market issuance/redemption fee (estimated ~50-100 bps) plus float income on cash held in segregated custody. Secondary trading on DEXs incurs no ST0x fee.
